title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical mirror
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical mirror-selfie portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, with delicate East Asian–appearing facial features, photographed in a modest residential interior. Her specific ethnicity is not established by appearance alone. She has smooth, fair skin with a soft neutral-warm undertone, naturally rosy cheeks, realistic fine skin texture, and subtle highlights along her face, collarbones, shoulders, arms, and legs. Her face is petite and softly oval, with a gently tapered jawline, delicate cheek contours, a small straight nose, naturally pink lips, and dark brown almond-shaped eyes. She wears understated feminine makeup, softly defined eyelashes, subtle eyeliner, and a gentle peach-pink blush. Her expression is calm and slightly playful, with a faint closed-mouth smile as she looks toward her smartphone screen.

Her hair is dark brown-black, straight, and shoulder-length, styled in a softly rounded bob with slightly inward-curving ends and full, wispy bangs resting just above her eyebrows. A few loose strands naturally frame her cheeks.

She has a softly curvaceous figure with a defined waist and natural proportions. She stands facing a full-length mirror, her torso angled slightly toward the right, holding a silver-gray smartphone with three rear cameras in her left hand at approximately face height. Her other arm bends behind her waist, partially concealed by her clothing. Her hips are gently shifted to one side, and her bare legs extend naturally toward the floor, with one knee subtly bent.

She wears a fitted, light-gray, finely striped mini dress with delicate spaghetti straps, a low sweetheart-inspired neckline, gathered fabric and a small twist detail at the center of the bust, a closely fitted waist, and a short, gently flared A-line skirt ending around her upper thighs. Over the dress is a lightweight, cropped ivory-white cardigan with loose three-quarter sleeves, worn open and casually draped over her shoulders and upper arms. Preserve the exact layered styling, garment lengths, fabric textures, neckline, and overall silhouette.

The environment is a simple apartment entryway or bedroom corner with warm cream-colored walls, a pale wooden doorframe, an electrical utility panel on the upper-left wall, and a light beige tiled floor with wooden skirting boards. A large fluffy cream-colored cat sits prominently in the lower foreground, partially obscuring her lower legs. A soft canvas tote bag rests at the bottom left, while a tall white shopping bag with dark handles stands at the bottom right.

Soft natural daylight enters indirectly from the left, creating gentle directional illumination, realistic shadows, and a warm, intimate domestic atmosphere. Eye-level mirror perspective, realistic smartphone photography, approximately 26mm equivalent wide-angle lens, natural depth of field, subtle photographic grain, authentic reflections, muted beige-gray color palette, softly cinematic tonal grading, balanced highlights, and lifelike proportions. Preserve the spontaneous, unposed quality of an everyday mirror selfie, with no studio lighting, exaggerated retouching, or artificial beautification. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, natural skin texture, high-resolution vertical composition, 9:16.
